BiblicalUsage: The word gûwd carries the sense of to attack, to overcome, a troop. In Genesis 49:19, the text says "a troop shall overcome him."
TheologicalSignificance: In gûwd I find no hidden theology; it simply means to attack, to overcome, a troop.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
